description: Windows member server baseline metrics (CPU, memory, disks, services, event log, hardware identity). PS1 内容与 1.0.8 一字不差 (只 bump 版本 + 补建表迁移), agent sync 拿到的 collect.ps1 sha 不变. 继承 R158.56c (3 个 JSON 列) + R158.30 (system_info/network_info/memory_modules) + R147 (bios/cpu_brand/disks).
